comment: What the probe trace of the Japanese 1.01 Biohazard.exe running under Classic REbirth 1.1.4 showed behaving as described (tools/Lockpick.Probe trace, owner playing Chris from the title: main hall, dining room, the corridor, killed by a zombie, back to the title). Applied by tools/re1/port_profile.py --live. Fields not listed stay static.
session: Classic REbirth 1.1.4, Chris new game to a death, owner, probe trace

fields.room: 0x1B for the intro, then 06 (main hall), 05 and 04, changing at each door.
fields.camera: Changes at the camera cuts while walking (21).
fields.hp: 140 at the start, down 10 per zombie bite to 0, then −10 at death.
fields.maxHp: 140 (Chris) from the start of the game.
fields.gameTimer: 0 at New Game, counting while playing (REbirth's own tick increments this same counter), frozen at 2 732 frames from the death until the title menu.
fields.mainMenu: 1 on the title menu, 0 once the game started, 1 again after the death.
fields.positionX: Changes as the player walks (54 positions in the trace context).
fields.positionZ: Changes as the player walks (54 positions in the trace context).
fields.inventoryPtr: Holds 0xC38814 (the inventory) from the start of Chris's game.
fields.inv1: First aid spray (0x41 x1) from the start.
fields.inv2: The Emblem (0x1F) at the moment it was picked up.
fields.enemy0Hp: −1 in the empty slot, then a zombie's HP (68, 65) in the dining room.
fields.enemy0Type: NPC 0x24 in the opening, then 0x11 in the dining room.
fields.flagRoomItems1: The Emblem's bit cleared at the moment it appeared in the inventory.

addresses.inventoryPointer: Holds the inventory's address (0xC38814) during Chris's game.
addresses.inventory: The slots above, as picked up.
addresses.itemBox: Its first entry is the box's starting Clip x15.
